name: close_document
description: Evict a session and release its lock/memory. Returns {ok:true,sessionId,dirty,discardedRevisions,warning?}: a dirty close warns (dirty:true + warning naming the discarded unsaved revision count) instead of silently discarding; save first when the warning matters. Example {"sessionId":"sess_abc"} -> {"ok":true,"dirty":false,"discardedRevisions":0}. Close when finished; expired sessions (30min idle) must be re-opened.
